posts.zh:
dsh-ticktick 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。基于官方 OAuth Open API 双向同步滴答清单（TickTick/Dida365）任务：拉取各清单任务、创建/更新/完成/删除、按标题去重的一键同步，带 Web 设置面板。

posts.en:
dsh-ticktick is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Two-way TickTick/Dida365 (滴答清单) task sync via the official OAuth Open API: pull tasks across lists, create/update/complete/delete tasks, and one-shot title-deduped sync, with a web settings panel.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-c8cc3323830003e0131c.html
